utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I bring it over?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Anytime after 6 works for me. Thanks, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring it over after 6.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and what needs to be hauled first so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the timing and which items need hauling first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to know the pickup window and the heaviest items first, so I can figure out if my car can handle it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I probably missed the latest update, but I’m in if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — that really helps. I’ll send you the details and we can sort out what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Oren — just send it over when you can, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the repair drive plan to the others and make sure everyone knows the details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Ira. I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan so everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane — it’s going well so far. I’ve got a few tools out and folks are still bringing things by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, glad to hear it. I’ll jump in and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just tell me the plan and where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—thanks, Eli! We’re meeting at my place Saturday at 10, then heading over to the community shed to sort tools and start on the fence.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 10 at your place works for me. I’ll be there ready to sort tools and help with the fence.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — is the repair drive still on for this weekend, and do you need any help?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Mina — yes, it’s still on this weekend, and I’d really appreciate the help. If you’re free, you can stop by Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I can stop by Saturday morning. What time should I come?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Start with the folks on Birch and Maple who flagged broken steps and a leaky sink. I can send you the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes please—send the list and I’ll start with Birch and Maple.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I still need someone to track donations and another person to coordinate pickup times. Could you take one of those?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can track the donations. Just send me the list and I’ll keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of what supplies we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — just keep it simple and let me know the main gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye on the main gaps and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a pretty good turnout—folks seem ready to pitch in. I can swing by later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Tess. I’m happy to help where I can, too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rey—I'll check in later and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what details do we need to check first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana—first let’s confirm the pickup date, what kinds of repairs we’re collecting, and whether the school needs volunteers for sorting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll confirm the pickup date, the repair types, and whether they need volunteers for sorting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the basics for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll grab the basics and let you know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — just the main items and where to drop them off is enough.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in — I’ll repeat the repair drive plan to the neighbors and make sure everyone knows what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that would help a lot. I’ll keep coordinating the list so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep it clear for everyone. Just send me any updates, and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you remind me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s alright, Noah — we just need a few basics for the repair drive: tools, tape, and any spare parts you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I can look for some tools and tape, and I’ll check around for spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive — what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly tools and a few extra hands—if you’ve got a drill, wrench set, or even just some time, I could use it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with some time, and I might have a wrench set too. When do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to drop things off. If you’d like, I can also help make a simple list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Rosa—thanks. I can help keep track of the drop-off spot and list what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Opal — thank you. I’ll put together the list, and we can keep the drop-off spot easy for everyone to find.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the exact timing and what needs to be moved first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the exact timing and a quick list of what needs moving first as soon as I have it. Thanks for being willing to help!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — that would help a lot. Once you have it, please send the timing and the first few items so I can plan.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — it’s still happening today. I’m just checking the details before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. What time are we heading out?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, but I need a clear plan for the repair drive first. Tell me what needs fixing and when you want to do it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, fair — I’ll put together a simple list of what needs fixing and a time that works, then circle back to you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Dane. Bring me the list and timing, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m glad it’s happening. Did they say what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly tools and a few fresh screws, I think. I’ll check the supply list and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be helpful. I can spread the word once you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to help organize it, but I’m a little fuzzy on the details; what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — could you help sort the donated items and set up the tables? If you can, I’d also appreciate you checking in with the volunteers when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I can sort the donations, set up the tables, and check in with the volunteers when I get there. Just remind me what time to arrive, and I’ll do my best not to forget.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive time first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send the repair drive time right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — send it over when you have it and I’ll work around school pickup.
